name: Zanlakol Ltd
summary: Zanlakol Ltd engages in the development, production, marketing, and sale of vegetable products in Israel. The company provides corn, peas, carrots, green beans, chickpeas, and other legumes. It also offers hummus and dips; cooking sauces, including pasta, pizza, lasagna, Bolognese, and omelet sauces; tomato products, such as crushed tomatoes, tomato pastes and concentrates, diced tomatoes, tomato omelet sauce, and spicy pepper salsa; and canned vegetable products comprising apple purees, beans, potatoes, mixed vegetables, corn kernels, carrots, chickpeas, and lupines.
